definitions: The flat surfaces of an object, typically not the top or bottom.
The parts of a person's or animal's body between the ribs and the hip.
Particular aspects or points of view of a matter or argument.
Teams or groups in a competition or conflict.
Dishes served in addition to the main course at a meal.
examples: He felt a pain in his sides.
There are two sides to every story.
We ordered extra sides with our meal.
